tagline: Homemade gumbo, po' boys, strong drinks and a Mardi Gras party every year on University Ave.

reviews.name: Maria Simatovich
reviews.text: The people that work here are very attentive, the service is so good, and the food is even better! I've never had gumbo, and there is never good food in Dubuque, but it is amazing here. The drinks are also strong, and you get a bang for your buck!

reviews.name: Kenny Bowling
reviews.text: I know it's a bar but they have some great food. Mini tacos, cheese curds, pretzel bites. My son loved their hot ham and cheese sandwich. Great prices for the amount of food. Bartender was courteous and manager was very nice!

reviews.name: Pete Pearson
reviews.text: Rico and staff, Happy Fat Tuesday 2025! Great Gumbo and Mardi Gras for 27 years!

reviews.name: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Large menu, best Friday off menu specials, and the old Cheers style atmosphere.
